description: This header file declares functions to configure trigger shapes specific to Honda vehicles within a larger engine control software project. It includes configuration functions for various Honda models and trigger patterns.

methods.name: configureHondaAccordCDDip
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Honda Accord with CD Dip pattern.

methods.name: configureHondaAccordShifted
methods.description: Configures shifted trigger shape for Honda Accord.

methods.name: configureHonda_1_4_24
methods.description: Configures a Honda trigger pattern with specific waveform signals and a parameter d.

methods.name: configureOnePlus16
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for a Honda model with a 1-16 pattern in a specific operation mode.

methods.name: configureHondaCbr600
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Honda CBR600 model.

methods.name: configureHondaCbr600custom
methods.description: Configures a custom trigger shape for Honda CBR600.
